ticket_summarization.label: Ticket Summarization
ticket_summarization.tooltip: Generates a concise TL;DR text summary right at the top of incoming customer support threads to save agent evaluation time.

sentiment_analysis.label: Sentiment Analysis
sentiment_analysis.tooltip: Evaluates the emotional tone of customer messages (e.g., Negative, Critical) to color-code triage priority tags dynamically.

smart_reply.label: Smart Reply
smart_reply.tooltip: Drafts automated context-aware text responses directly within the ticket response composer window for rapid execution.

kb_generation.label: KB Generation
kb_generation.tooltip: Converts closed, high-quality resolution threads into draft document suggestions inside the GeistKB repository.

escalation_analysis.label: Escalation Analysis
escalation_analysis.tooltip: Monitors response drift and customer urgency signals to auto-route critical tickets to manager queues before SLA breaches.

root_cause_analysis.label: Root Cause Analysis
root_cause_analysis.tooltip: Identifies systemic clusters among incoming issues to automatically flag system bugs to the engineering backlogs.

translation.label: Translation
translation.tooltip: Instantly translates incoming messages to the agent's system language, and translates outgoing replies back to the customer's language.

vault_insights.label: Vault Insights
vault_insights.tooltip: Scans data encryption strengths and key lifecycles to surface security recommendations on the GeistVault compliance dashboard.
